_doc: Loot profiles: which item categories a source rolls (relative int weights), how many rolls it makes and its rarity floor (index into rarity.json tiers). 'lab' is the Loot Lab profile (rest menu > Admin Options). Container profiles (Phase 3) add: gear_chance (per-mille, per roll), gold_pct (mean gold per fill as a % of the Common budget at the loot level, paid 50-150% of that), gem_chance (per-mille: the gold is paid as treasure.json gems instead, up to 3, rest in gold) and consumables ([min, max] picks from consumables.json). Missing keys default to rolls 1, floor 0, gear_chance 1000, no gold, no consumables. creature / boss are the creature-drop profiles (Phase 4); creatures says which class a slain creature is and how often it drops. Profile names are <= 16 chars [a-z0-9_]. scripts: placeable script -> profile; gen-loot-tables.py --apply GENERATES each as a thin wrapper .nss in unpacked/ (mode refill = the 200 s respawning chest, once = the stock open/bash-once behaviour; custom = a hand-written script that is NOT generated but must call its profile by name, e.g. the three Setti coffers with their one-hour cooldown). A profile's optional bases list restricts it to those base-item rows (named-pool awards included). area_overrides: {area resref: {level, reason}} for areas whose chests have no hostile creatures to set a level from (gen-area-loot-levels.py --suggest).

creatures._doc: Creature drops (Phase 4): a PC-credited kill of a creature in a hostile faction (repute.fac reputation toward PCs <= 10, the same rule as the area levels) may leave rolled items on its corpse, on top of its fixed loot. Class: boss = in the Roll of the Fallen registry (brd_db.nss); elite = its CR loot level is at least its area's loot level + elite_margin, or listed in elite_include (and not in elite_exclude); normal otherwise. chance is per mille per kill; profile is the sources profile rolled (its rolls and rarity_floor). The roll is at the creature's own CR loot level (levels.json; boss_overrides pins a boss). Bosses add one roll at CR >= extra_roll_cr and a separate named-pool roll at named_chance per mille. exclude: {resref: reason} never drops (quest creatures). Review the effect with python3 bin/loot-sim.py --creatures (--write regenerates CLAUDE-loot-creature-audit.md).
